messages:
sam: Observed repeated KV-store OOMs on Dedicated cluster this morning when replaying long-context traces (~65k tokens). Paging spikes, then eviction churn. Anyone else seeing this?

infra-bot: Alert: node-gpu-03 memory-high -> 2026-02-24T09:12:10Z

anya: Yep, saw similar on private-onprem lab yesterday. Differences: Dedicated was using mem-guard=off, private had mem-guard=on but with small page_size=4KB. Might be config drift.

dara: Can you paste profiler snippet? curious about per-shard cache growth + fragmentation.

sam: paste logs and perf counters: 
```
KV_CACHE: total_entries=2,384,012 used_bytes=58.1GiB pages=9,412 page_faults=23,441
EVICT: scanned=12,082 reclaimed=1,240 time_ms=880
FRAG: free_runs=1023 avg_run=48B
```

mike: that fragmentation avg_run=48B is suspicious. small free runs -> allocator is fragmenting under long token sequences. On A100s we saw similar when sequence_len distribution heavy tail.

anya: Dedicated default eviction_policy=LIFO; Hosted uses LRU. LIFO + big batches => hotspots that never age -> page pressure.

sam: Confirmed: switching Dedicated to LRU cut page faults by ~65% in a quick test (local replica). But on private onprem switching breaks perf due to NUMA + VFIO mapping in our VPC config.

dara: NUMA? what's the symptom?

sam: pages get remapped causing 20-40ms jitter per token. Stacktrace snippet: 
```
slowpath: kv_page_fault_handler -> remap_vma -> dma_map_sg -> stall
```

mike: For on-prem we've been avoiding huge contiguous allocations due to older drivers. Suggest trying smaller page_size=2MB -> reduces fragmentation, but increases TLB churn. tradeoffs.

anya: Also saw batching heuristic interacting: large continuous batching (auto-batch window=50ms) coalesces many long seqs -> KV reuse increases but also creates hot-kv-write bursts that evict cold entries. Recommend adaptive batching by seq_len buckets.

dara: Agree. Proposed action items: 1) run a controlled replay across Hosted/Dedicated/Private with same seed; 2) experiment eviction=Lru + page_size=2MB on Dedicated; 3) onprem driver patch to reduce remap stalls; 4) add perf counters for kv_write_hotness and kv_reuse_hits.

sam: I'm running step 1 now against 3 clusters, will post results. small note: hosted has extra caching layer (redis prefix cache) — might hide some of these effects.

mike: FYI I've got a patch that adds kv_reuse_hits counter and exposes per-shard fragmentation histo. I'll push a preview later today. @anya can you validate on private? :thumbsup:

anya: yes, will validate once patch lands. also can we add an alert: kv_page_fault_rate > 100/s for 5m -> pager?

sam: Added to TODO. thanks all.
